main_text.l: summo eoque ineffabili amore complectantur et in
æternis delitijs habeant. Atque ita hoc perpetui visus re-
spectu charitas est maior fide et spe. ipræstat ijs, vt-
cunque vno nomine inferior sit. Neque enim charitas
sed fides totius humanæ sanctitatis basis et fundamen-
tum et nunc est et in futuro sæculo ita manebit. Ergo

page.notes: The running head and heading are set as printed: "1. Ad Corinthios" at top centre and "Cap. 15" at top right. The marginal notes "Ergo" and "Cap." are in the right margin.
